objective: A learned champion that reliably defeats pinned Supalosa, with Laya, NanoJev, Jev-Omni and repeated cross-model learning in a reproducible pipeline.
note: Normal vision and decision opportunities are shared. The model controller submits at most one command; baseline retains its original cap. This is not equal realized command throughput.

outcomes.win: engine ended and learned seat outcome is 1; no truncation
outcomes.errors: non-win; must also pass reliability gate

completionEvidence: at least two completed learning generations from cross-model self-play
checkpoint hashes, lineage, data splits, command/config snapshots
one-command pipeline resume and champion reproduction
statisticalCaveat: Repeated seeds may produce correlated or identical trajectories. Wilson is a descriptive operational gate, not an independence guarantee. Report per-map/seat results and trajectory diversity.
